PREFACE.


AFTER  unavoidable  delays,  Volume  V  of  The  Guid-
ing Symptoms  is  presented  to  the  medical  pro-
fession, published  by  the  heirs  of  Constantine  Hering.

The  American  Homoeopathic  Publishing  Society,
which  had  contracted  to  publish  the  complete  work,
through  lack  of  business  facilities,  was  compelled  to
relinquish  the  pleasant  task  after  the  publication  of
the  fourth  volume,  but  has  made  provision  for  the  com-
pletion of  the  work  by  the  Hering  heirs,  the  editorship
remaining  the  same.

The  editors  take  pleasure  in  acknowledging  the
clerical  labors  of  Drs.  Rudolph  Bauer  and  Edwin  H.
Kistler,  who  have  worked  assiduously  on  the  present
volume,  and  who  have  been  induced  to  continue  their
aid  so  as  to  insure  the  rapid  completion  of  the  remain-
ing volumes.

C.  G.  Raue,

Condorplant.  Asdepiadacese.
